narratives.Overview: Write-default still 0.6 while schema const is 0.8.
narratives.UserStory: As a new Directive consumer, I want init and templates to write xBRIEFInfo version 0.8, so that the first doctor session does not report behind-major against schema 0.8.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Update content/templates/project.md.template and setup skill samples so copy sources emit xBRIEFInfo 0.8. Step 2: Ensure packages/cli/src/init-cli writers stamp 0.8. Step 3: packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts surfaces migrate:xbrief next action for 0.6 docs. Step 4: Convert xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json dogfood to xBRIEFInfo@0.8. Verify with vitest doctor tests. drive-to: merge-ready. Closes #2971. CHANGELOG.md may be edited last with unique Unreleased bullets (shared non-exclusive).

narrative.Acceptance: Given an agent copies content/templates project template text, the sample JSON emits xBRIEFInfo.version 0.8 not 0.6.
When init creates project xBRIEF JSON via packages/cli/src/init-cli, the written file returns xBRIEFInfo.version 0.8.
Given a project JSON at 0.6 under xbrief layout, doctor fails closed with a message that records migrate:xbrief as the next action.
When dogfood PROJECT-DEFINITION is opened, it returns a single xBRIEFInfo.version 0.8 without dual vBRIEFInfo half-state.
